name: Image Compressor
description: Shrink JPEG, PNG and WebP images in batches, offline, and compare the result with the original
help: Add images or whole folders (JPEG, PNG and WebP), or drop them onto the window, then press Compress. Everything runs on this computer; no image is uploaded.
JPEG is re-encoded with mozjpeg. A quality of 70–80 usually looks the same as the original at a fraction of the size.
Lossy PNG reduces the image to at most 256 colors with dithering (like TinyPNG / pngquant) and keeps transparency. Lossless PNG only repacks the data, so every pixel stays identical.
WebP is usually the smallest format and is supported by all modern browsers.
Color profiles are always kept. Camera details and GPS location are removed unless “Keep EXIF metadata” is on; photos are rotated upright when the metadata is removed.
Originals are never changed. Results are saved next to the originals with the suffix, or in the chosen folder. If compressing would make a file larger, the original is copied instead.
Press the compare button on a result to drag a divider between the original and the compressed image.
